title: THE SPLITTER
briefing: ARGUS's last stand on the surface is an isotope splitter. A heavy core can be split into two fragments, and two fragments can be fused back into one core. Nothing is ever lost, but nothing is counted one for one either. If the fragment chamber ever holds 7 or more, the containment field fails.

intro: A BRIDGE. AN AIRLOCK. LUCK, BOTH OF THEM.
MY LAST SURFACE FACILITY: A SPLITTER.
COUNT THE PIECES, LAWSMITH. I DARE YOU.
